module: File 04 — News Feed and Publishing — Legacy Foundation Adapter

rounds.correction: Runtime is adapter-only; File 21 is declared canonical and no new feed/composer owner is present.
rounds.finding: Historical code risked acting as a second publishing system.

rounds.correction: Header, runtime and schema were aligned at 1.2.0.
rounds.finding: Prior package/document identity remained at 1.2.0.

rounds.correction: Fail-closed current identity/2FA and File 21 package/runtime/class gates are required.
rounds.finding: Migration operations could not trust mere feature detection.

rounds.correction: Network-wide activation is rejected; activation is per site only.
rounds.finding: Network-wide activation could produce cross-site ownership and migration ambiguity.

rounds.correction: Pre-activation table baseline and compensating removal of only newly-created adapter tables were added.
rounds.finding: A failed activation could leave newly-created adapter tables behind.

rounds.correction: All global flushes were removed in favor of targeted File 21/cutover invalidation hooks.
rounds.finding: Global cache flushing was over-broad and could disrupt unrelated modules.

rounds.correction: Unsafe unserialize/maybe_unserialize paths were removed; evidence is treated as untrusted data.
rounds.finding: Legacy evidence could be materialized through unsafe unserialization.

rounds.correction: Canonicalization and deterministic JSON encoding now cover arrays, objects, resources and special floats.
rounds.finding: Associative order, objects and non-finite values could yield unstable evidence hashes.

rounds.correction: Inventory captures source records, comments, terms, attachments, interactions, routes and table fingerprints.
rounds.finding: Inventory evidence needed exact source-schema and data signatures.

rounds.correction: All source traversal is cursor/keyset bounded; OFFSET is absent.
rounds.finding: OFFSET pagination could skip or repeat records during concurrent legacy changes.

rounds.correction: Inventory and legacy-page discovery explicitly inspect database errors and fail closed.
rounds.finding: Database read errors could be misread as empty inventory.

rounds.correction: Quarantine completion now requires exact restoration evidence to persist or activation fails.
rounds.finding: Page quarantine evidence persistence failure could be ignored.

rounds.correction: Lifecycle state/version is re-read under locks and transitions remain optimistic-version guarded.
rounds.finding: State/version checks could become stale while waiting for locks.

rounds.correction: A reusable revalidate_actor gate now compares the current canonical actor under every critical lock.
rounds.finding: The authenticated actor could change while a protected operation waited for a lock.

rounds.correction: State, version, IDs, hashes, limits and confirmation fields now have explicit REST validation.
rounds.finding: Mutation routes previously lacked uniform bounded schemas.

rounds.correction: Header/body equality, printable content and 16–190 length are enforced.
rounds.finding: Conflicting header/body keys or weak keys could permit replay ambiguity.

rounds.correction: All REST success/error evidence is private no-store and noindex/noarchive.
rounds.finding: Sensitive migration evidence could be cached or indexed.

rounds.correction: CLI now recognizes 0/false/no for --with-interactions.
rounds.finding: A textual false value could still enable interaction migration.

rounds.correction: Minimum package 1.0.3.2 and runtime contract 1.0.3 are frozen.
rounds.finding: An obsolete File 21 minimum could accept an incompatible target.

rounds.correction: Target type, File 21 mapping and both legacy provenance metadata fields are verified.
rounds.finding: A target ID alone did not prove correct File 21 ownership.

rounds.correction: Containment now calls File 21 LegacyPublicationRollback only; no direct post/table write exists in the adapter.
rounds.finding: Containment fallback could mutate File 21 posts directly.

rounds.correction: Mapping and canonical target are re-read and validated after operation/migration locks.
rounds.finding: Interaction resume could rely on mapping state read before lock acquisition.

rounds.correction: Table/column probes and source queries now produce explicit fail-closed errors.
rounds.finding: Missing/query-failed interaction schemas could silently look empty.

rounds.correction: Source-record, canonical-row and ledger operations return/propagate WP_Error.
rounds.finding: Reaction ledger reads/inserts needed explicit database-failure handling.

rounds.correction: Save records use the bounded canonical interaction ledger and checked queries.
rounds.finding: Save deduplication and contribution evidence required the same fail-closed behavior.

rounds.correction: Exact contribution-ledger handling and query-error gates cover aggregate and table views.
rounds.finding: Meta-only and table views could be undercounted or silently lost.

rounds.correction: Reports are migrated through the typed ledger with missing-user/schema blockers.
rounds.finding: Reports require preserved reason/status and verified user provenance.

rounds.correction: Group, contribution and original-row reads now return WP_Error and rollback propagates failures.
rounds.finding: Canonical group/contribution reads could convert DB failures to zero.

rounds.correction: Dry-run cleanup uses scoped DELETE operations; TRUNCATE is absent.
rounds.finding: TRUNCATE could destroy unrelated/simultaneous evidence.

rounds.correction: Actor is revalidated under lock; mapping reads are checked; source-only evidence stays nonpublic.
rounds.finding: Quarantine decisions needed fresh actor checks and mapping-ledger error handling.

rounds.correction: Existing run is checked both before and after locks; corrupt/stale ledgers fail closed.
rounds.finding: A duplicate idempotency key could be inserted after the pre-lock check.

rounds.correction: get_checked, fail-closed conflict codes and PHP_INT_MAX blocker count were added.
rounds.finding: Mapping/conflict DB errors could masquerade as absent records or zero conflicts.

rounds.correction: Current actor, SHA-256, UTC recency, restored counts, source signature and independent verifier are required.
rounds.finding: Backup evidence could be recorded by a stale actor or without source-bound restore proof.

rounds.correction: Count reads fail closed and every target uses full canonical provenance validation.
rounds.finding: Disposition count query errors and invalid canonical targets could produce a false green report.

rounds.correction: Actor/state are revalidated and provider-verified cache invalidation plus search reindex evidence is mandatory.
rounds.finding: Cutover could proceed with stale actor/state or assumed cache/search completion.

rounds.correction: Canonical targets use 301; quarantined/fallback tombstones use 410 without false 404 state.
rounds.finding: Temporary redirects and 404 marking of gone records weakened canonicality.

rounds.correction: Checkpoint failures now stop before interaction rollback; full target checksum/provenance gates protect changed/new File 21 data.
rounds.finding: Interaction reversal could begin before local rollback checkpoint persistence.

rounds.correction: Retirement revalidates actor/state/source, verifies route handoff and requires confirmed deactivation.
rounds.finding: Retirement could report success even if actor/state changed or plugin deactivation failed.

rounds.correction: Deterministic canonical-folder build, dependency manifest, CycloneDX SBOM, source inventory, release lock, secret scan and PHP 8.1/8.3 CI are included.
rounds.finding: The prior artifact did not preserve a 40-round, exact-source reproducible evidence set.

rounds.correction: Fresh static, unit, architecture, packaging and all 40 scoped checks pass with zero known source-scope blockers.
rounds.finding: A final cross-cutting pass was required after all corrections.

truthful_boundary: Locally reviewable source and reproducible package only; Hostinger staging, real File 00/File 21 integrations, browser/WCAG/RTL, backup/restore rehearsal, Founder acceptance, live deployment and operations remain separate gates.
